title: Cadre Lane Contract
description: The universal adapter: any model, CLI agent, GUI bot, MCP server, or human becomes a lane.

identity.description: Optional named-agent class that persists across runs (e.g. 'sol-class'), carrying memory and quirks.

good_at.description: Task classes this lane handles well; feeds the router's fit matching.

cost.description: Economic class: free (local), metered (per-token), plan (rides a subscription you own), rollover (use-it-or-lose-it credits), coffee (a human).

proves.description: What checkable evidence this lane can produce for the gate.

craft.description: Named, versioned skills this lane swears by (skills-framework-style).

invoke.description: Adapter-specific invocation details (command template, endpoint, prompt wrapper).
